verses.1: They set up banners in Zion, and they praised God on the Holy Mountain. All the inhabitants of the earth were filled with joy, for it was said that the day of Jehovah had come.
verses.2: It will be a day of darkness and gloom. It will be a day of clouds and fog. When the darkness covers the mountains, with its thick clouds, it will never end in this world. And after that, it will not be repeated again for another two generations.
verses.3: Before him, fire burned; after him, flames flickered like a garden of Eden on earth. Before him and after him, there was also darkness, and there was no relief for him at all.
verses.4: As for horses, they should be seen as such; and just as arrows are also seen as arrows.
verses.5: Like the sound of horses galloping atop the mountains, they danced like the sound of fire burning through hard wood. They were like a people filled with anger and hatred, ready for battle.
verses.6: From his side, nations of all kinds would gather together. They would form a great crowd.
verses.7: As leaders, they will be respected by those who are warriors. They will rise up and go forward in their paths, and no one will harm them.
verses.8: And their brothers shall not be pushed aside. They shall go along with the messenger; they shall not be harmed.
verses.9: In the city, people will live in peace and harmony. They will go up to the hills to enjoy their time there. They will come as thieves.
verses.10: Before him, the earth was in turmoil; the heavens were filled with noise. Stars and constellations gathered together in chaos.
verses.11: And Jehovah gave him a loud voice before his army, because many people gathered together to oppose him. But he continued to do what was right in the day of Jehovah’s glory and great splendor. Who could withstand him?
verses.12: And even now, let the LORD be with me in every heart and mind, and in all our actions.
verses.13: And humble your hearts and repent of your sins. Return to Jehovah, your God. For He is merciful and forgiving. His kindness and compassion are infinite. He will comfort you in times of trouble.
verses.14: Who knows when there will be peace and comfort, and when they will be left behind with blessings, offerings, and sacrifices to the LORD our God.
verses.15: They set up a trumpet in Zion, and they called out “Arrah.”
verses.16: A holy assembly was gathered. The elders, the old men, and those who were considered “holy” people came together. A bride came out of her room, and all the others also came out of their hiding places.
verses.17: Between the altar and the incense offering, the priests, servants of Jehovah, will offer their prayers. They will say, “May Jehovah have mercy on your people! Do not let your land be given over to those who can bring them harm.” What will they say in other nations? What will their gods say?
verses.18: And the LORD cared for His people and protected them.
verses.19: And Jehovah said to His people, “I am sending you the rod of discipline, along with the judgment and punishment. I will not give you any further punishment in those lands.”
verses.20: And I will drive the sun away from you, and I will cast it into the land of darkness and gloom. Its face will be turned towards the ancient sea, and its light will shine on the other sea. It will rise up in flames, and its rays will spread everywhere.
verses.21: Do not be afraid, O land, and do not be sorrowful, for the LORD will increase your joy.
verses.22: Do not be afraid of the dead animals that have died from the storm. For they are like trees that bear fruit; they produce grapes and figs.
verses.23: And the children of Zion saw and rejoiced in your God, for He gave you the law of righteousness. And He sent rain upon you, along with locusts and gnats at first.
verses.24: And the graves were filled with dead bodies; and the tombs were opened, and the treasures were revealed.
verses.25: And I have fulfilled for you those years in which the wild oxen, the heifers, and the calves ate up my great army.
verses.26: And you ate and drank, and you praised the name of Jehovah your God, who has done wonders for you. He will not put my people to shame forever.
verses.27: Know that I, Jehovah your God, am near to Israel. And no longer will My people be destroyed forever.
